title: TCP: Initialize 'tcp_snd_manual_analysis' field.
description:
Valgrind warns that the tcp_snd_manual_analysis field in tcp_per_packet_data_t
might be used uninitialized.  Its existing initialization (on line 8122) is
conditional, but its value may be used on line 2711 even if it was never
written.  Let's zero the field upon allocation.

notes.body: I made tons of tests on this feature and didn't encounter any unitialized thing. How reliable is this warning ?

Highly reliable but not 100% perfect.  I'll work on constructing and analyzing a minimal repro case...  Valgrind+tshark reported it when analyzing [the "Ultimate Wireshark Protocols" capture file from the wiki](https://wiki.wireshark.org/uploads/26c41b5ec1d89343e2979b73ec374bc9/ultimate_wireshark_protocols_pcap_220213.pcap.zip) with valgrind-3.19.0 on Debian 12.1.

Ah, here's the minimal repro case: [ultimate-trimmed.pcapng.gz](/uploads/8bb4ce7935b5314021a504c5b13bcfee/ultimate-trimmed.pcapng.gz), created using `editcap -r ultimate_wireshark_protocols_pcap_220213.pcap /tmp/ultimate-trimmed.pcapng 213655-213655`.  Run `valgrind -- ../wireshark-ninja/run/tshark -Vnr /tmp/ultimate-trimmed.pcapng.gz` or similar.
